test_title: PYST 59: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"continued".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Continued -** Go on without stopping, resumed after interruption.

 
 
• **For example - ***They continued fighting even after the police came.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Promoted **- to encourage.

 
 
• **For example - ***Citizens should encourage good relations between the countries.*
 
 
 
• **Maintained -** to make something continue at the same level.
 
 
• **For example **- *Company should maintain the level of goods.*
 
 
 
• **Progressed -** to become better or to develop.
 
 
• **For example -*** Technology has progressed in the last twenty years.*
